name: Temp Mail
author: Ahmad Elyan
description: Disposable 10 or 30 minute email addresses with an inbox in the Omarchy bar, so you can sign up on websites without your real email. Powered by mail.tm.

barWidget.description: A throwaway email address with a countdown and an inbox.

schema.label: Default lifetime (minutes)
schema.description: How long a new address lives before it is deleted.

schema.label: Extend by (minutes)
schema.description: Time added by the + button. An address never lives more than 60 minutes from now.

schema.label: Icon only in the bar
schema.description: Hide the countdown; hover for the address and time left.
